% TeX Live PGF manual example for a named custom plot mark.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{plotmarks}

\pgfdeclareplotmark{my plot mark}
  {\pgfpathcircle{\pgfpoint{0cm}{1ex}}{1ex}\pgfusepathqstroke}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[gray] (0,0) node {x} (1,1) node {y} (2,.5) node {z};
  \draw[blue,mark=my plot mark,mark size=3pt]
    plot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1) (2,.5)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
